reasons: Classification is correct: Section 4.1 provides automatic 12-month renewals (acceptable term length) but a 90-day exit notice window, which fails the fallback ceiling of 60 days on a material term, so a deviation finding with a redline is warranted (and 90 days is not yet walk-away territory).

The redline is the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position — only 'ninety (90)' becomes 'thirty (30)' (changed-character ratio 0.089), leaving the one-year renewal term and the rest of the clause intact.
The comment is accurate, concise, in-voice, cites the preferred position (30 days' notice on automatic 12-month renewals) and offers the 60-day fallback.

Treating the absent vendor reminder and uplift cap as passing notes is consistent with the classification rules, and the rationale correctly explains that fees are a share of Net Sales with no uplift mechanic to cap.
